operation_id.description: Optional retry identity scoped to this principal, connection and document. An unchanged mutation replays its original result for 24 hours, even after later edits; its expired identity never executes again. A read replays while its receipt is retained; after 256 later reads it executes afresh. Reusing an identity with changed arguments refuses. Visual observations are fresh. Inspect before starting another operation. Calls without it never replay.
